methodologyNotes: Covers multi-day internal- and external-frame backpacking backpacks (overnight to expedition load carriers) sold at a published US MSRP. Excludes daypacks under 30 L, hydration vests, tactical/military ruck systems, and travel/wheeled luggage. Price is MSRP or typical US retail in USD. capacityLiters is the manufacturer's stated total volume in liters for the reference (regular/medium) torso size; where a size range shifts volume, the medium is used. weightGrams is the manufacturer's spec weight of the complete pack (with lid/brain, no accessories removed) for the regular/medium size, converted to grams. maxLoadKg is the manufacturer's recommended maximum comfortable carry load in kilograms; null if not disclosed. frameType is an enum of internal, external, or frameless. torsoRangeCm is the fitted torso length the pack accommodates in centimeters, given as a range (e.g. 41-53) for adjustable suspensions or a single value for fixed; the reference size is used for fixed-length models. materialDenier is the denier (D) of the main body fabric; where multiple deniers are used, the primary bodyfabric is listed. numExternalPockets is the count of distinct external stow pockets (hipbelt, side, front/shove-it, lid), integer. hydrationCompatible is a boolean for an internal reservoir sleeve plus hose port. rainCoverIncluded is a boolean for an integrated or bundled rain cover. accessType is an enum describing how the main compartment opens: top for top-loading only, top-bottom for top plus a bottom/sleeping-bag zip, panel for a front U-zip panel, or hybrid for top plus front panel access. ventilatedBack is a boolean for a suspended/trampoline mesh back panel that holds the pack body off the wearer's back.
